_README: Copy this file to <client-id>.json, set id to that same filename, and fill it in. Files starting with _ are ignored by the loader, so this one is never treated as a client. Then: npm run cli -- client add --client <client-id>
name: Example Client Pvt Ltd
niche: what the business actually does, in a sentence
_keywordsNote: Point targetUrl at the real landing page for each keyword, not the homepage. A deep link to the page that answers the query is worth considerably more than another homepage link, and the anchor then matches where it leads.

content._comment: facts is the ONLY source of specifics the writer may state about this client. Leave it empty and the writer is instructed to say nothing specific about the business at all. Get these from the client, never from a model.
content.tone: plain, practical, written for the person actually deciding
content.audience: who is reading, and what they are trying to decide
forbidden: percentages or figures the client has not verified
claims of being 'the best' or 'number one'
mustInclude: a concrete takeaway a reader can act on without buying anything

quotas._comment: Low on purpose. Forty links in an afternoon from one IP, all pointing at one domain, is the footprint that gets a profile discounted.

approval._comment: Blog articles wait for a human; everything else goes automatically. Template-generated copy always waits, whatever is listed here.
